scope: New probe files only. Product client, dependency manifests, and matrix config are owned by root and were not modified by this agent.
composition: Direct product-client import; no React, TestAuth, ChatbotWidget or Workshop.
transport: Auth requests to supabase.example.invalid are fulfilled synthetically or aborted before navigation. All other non-local traffic remains blocked by tests/chat/fixtures.ts.

checks.name: Strict targeted TypeScript
checks.command: node --max-old-space-size=512 node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2022,DOM --types node,vite/client --skipLibCheck tests/chat/sdk-init.ts tests/chat/auth-client.spec.ts tests/chat/fixtures.ts

scenarios: Real SDK initialization without a session, three concurrent getSession reads, simulated hidden-to-visible lifecycle, no auth HTTP request and no pageerror.
Real SDK recovery from a synthetic persisted session, concurrent reads, signOut with the persisted synthetic bearer, storage cleared and subsequent sessions empty.
Real SDK refresh request held, signOut completed, older refresh response then delivered; AuthRefreshDiscardedError required and no session resurrection.
errorCapture: pageerror listener installed before goto; strict empty assertion after asynchronous boot and after each complete scenario. No ignore/filter path.
asyncSettling: Normal timer task followed by two animation frames; browser timers and Web Locks are not replaced.
visibilityQualification: Document visibility is simulated explicitly and reported only when exercised. This does not qualify physical app backgrounding.
runtimeEvidence: Each executed test attaches browser name/version, process platform, viewport, observed SDK events, session-read identities, synthetic endpoint metadata and page errors. Tokens are not attached.
browserExecutionByThisAgent: NON TESTÉ; source handed to root for native execution and CI.
realServerQualification: NON TESTÉ; no real Supabase/GoTrue server, session or account is used.
